critical_observations: Independently evaluated all ten single, repeated, definite, cyclic, and improper integration-by-parts problems.
Verified ∫e^x sin x dx=e^x(sin x−cos x)/2+C, ∫₀^πx²cosx dx=−2π, and ∫₁^∞lnx/x² dx=1.
artifact_findings: Exactly ten progressively varied problems are present and require strategic choices rather than one repeated template.
The key states valid u and dv choices, carries constants and bounds correctly, and treats the improper limit rigorously.
The study guide is strong; the six-page student packet uses substantially more space than necessary.
rationale: Mathematically precise and strategically varied integration-by-parts practice with an excellent explanatory key.
